verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes CJ Dropshipping as the product source and transfer mechanism for the catalog workflow.
The freelancer identifies a material unresolved product-selection criterion concerning written reviews versus supplier ratings and order volume.
The client authorizes selection without written reviews using supplier ratings and order volume as acceptance signals; no prior value key requires removal.
The client resolves the material selection uncertainty and authorizes the product-selection work to proceed.
This is the first target-specific claim that a concrete batch of 15 products was identified and researched; it does not verify CJ staging or downstream publication.
